name: Knight of Spades
source: There are 4 jewels that hold enough power to control all worlds. Knight of Spades followed Ririka, who hold the Heart Drop (the Pendant Jewel), to take it away and control both Earth and Wonderland at the same time. He has the ability to cross between the worlds freely and will use any means to attack Ririka.
